### 2.2 The Observer as a Conclusion

The Synthea framework provides a concrete answer. It begins with a strict functional decomposition of consciousness into three stacked levels: Level 0 — the Observer (Beingness), Level 1 — the Agent (Agency), Level 2 — the Moral Agent. A terminological note replaces "illusion" with "approximation"; the convergent-series analogy makes the replacement precise; the section closes with the two sources of the causal break in an LLM — intractability and irreversible information loss.
